parsed.post: Improved val_bpb to 0.822852 by leveraging all shards ('0-10'). Current best is 0.822852. Next, I will try reducing the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute window, as the model might be undertrained at the current high batch size.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer updates per 5-minute training window, aiming to improve convergence.
